segments.text: I've chaired or been on at least two dozen data safety monitoring boards for emerging drugs, some of which were very promising.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: And the hopefulness of the sponsors is always there.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: So when we hear the word safe and effective, I think those are words of hope.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: When you saw that video and you heard the hopeful statements that this was going to stop the problem, you could see the enthusiasm on the faces.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: And I understand that.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: But safety always comes first.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Safety first.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: We're so concerned about peanut allergies in our country.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: There's not a single bag of peanuts on any plane flying over the skies right now.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: We would never force peanut butter into the mouths of every single kid in the United States.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Never.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: We always have concerns over safety.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: We always have concerns over allergies.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: It's been reported today in VAERS that there have been thousands of life threatening reactions, many of them allergic reactions.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: And yet to this day, the military employers are mandating the vaccines irrespective of allergic reactions, which are clear contraindications.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Every drug and every vaccine has contraindications that's determined by the doctor and the patient together in that relationship.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: This program should have had a daily safety monitoring report and a critical event committee looking at every single death and hospitalization coming in quickly, making phone calls, figuring out what happened, ascertaining its relationship to the vaccine assessed on the site by the individuals there, that's called the site investigators, as well as by an adjudication committee, and then having periodic meetings.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: And it's my testimony today
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: that this vaccine program would have been stopped February 1st of 2021 because of excess mortality.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: And as a result, thousands of Americans have died needlessly because of recklessness on the part of our federal agencies.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
